flow.name: corrections-post-flow
flow.doc:description: Applies an approved RESTOCK or REISSUE once per key; 201 when applied now, 200 when the key was already applied

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'INIT - Correction ' ++ vars.correction.'type' ++ ', orderId: ' ++ vars.orderId ++ ' key: ' ++ vars.correction.key ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the start of the correction

choice.doc:description: RESTOCK needs the item, the provider and the quantity

when.expression: #[vars.correction.'type' == 'RESTOCK' and (vars.correction.itemId == null or vars.correction.provider == null or vars.correction.quantity == null)]

raise-error.description: RESTOCK needs itemId, provider and quantity

http:request.doc:description: The order to correct (404 when it does not exist)

choice.doc:description: 404 when the order does not exist

when.doc:description: The order is not in the ERP

http:request.doc:description: The latest dispatch note of the order, if any

flow-ref.name: corrections-reissue-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: New dispatch note with the next sequence

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: vars.orderId, "type": vars.correction."type", key: vars.correction.key, (restock: vars.restockMovement) if (vars.restockMovement != null), (outbound: vars.outboundMovements) if (vars.outboundMovements != null), dispatchNote: vars.dispatchNote }

set-variable.doc:description: 201 when applied now, 200 when the key was already applied

logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'END - Correction ' ++ vars.correction.'type' ++ ', orderId: ' ++ vars.orderId ++ ' appliedNow: ' ++ (vars.appliedNow default false) ++ ' correlationId: ' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:description: Logs the end of the correction (no order.registered, D18)

sub-flow.name: corrections-restock-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Restock (reference = key), outbound per line (reference = key-out-itemId) and the dispatch note if the order has none

http:request.doc:description: Restock: 201 the first time, 200 with the original when the key repeats (D7)
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { itemId: vars.correction.itemId, 'type': 'RESTOCK', quantity: vars.correction.quantity, reference: vars.correction.key, orderId: vars.orderId }]

raise-error.description: The item to restock does not exist

set-variable.doc:description: 201 means this key is applied now

http:request.doc:description: Outbound of the line; registered once per key (D7)
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { itemId: payload.itemId, 'type': 'OUTBOUND', quantity: payload.quantity, reference: vars.correction.key ++ '-out-' ++ payload.itemId, orderId: vars.orderId }]

choice.doc:description: Even after the restock the stock may not be enough

raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'The stock is still not enough for item ' ++ vars.order.lines[vars.counter - 1].itemId]

choice.doc:description: The dispatch note is dropped once: an existing one is reused

when.doc:description: The order has no dispatch note

otherwise.doc:description: Already dispatched (the key was applied before)

sub-flow.name: corrections-reissue-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: New dispatch note only while the latest one is REJECTED; otherwise the reissue is already applied

choice.doc:description: Only a rejected dispatch note is reissued

flow-ref.name: corrections-drop-dispatch-subflow
flow-ref.doc:description: Drops the dispatch note with the next sequence

raise-error.description: The order has no rejected dispatch note to reissue

sub-flow.name: corrections-drop-dispatch-subflow
sub-flow.doc:description: Drops the order dispatch note (sapi-sftp-orders assigns the next sequence)

http:request.doc:description: Name and delivery address for the dispatch note
Drops the dispatch note into the logistics pending folder
http:request.http:body: #[output application/json --- { orderId: vars.orderId, customer: { name: payload.name, address: payload.address }, lines: vars.order.lines map ((l) -> { sku: l.sku, quantity: l.quantity }) }]
